title: Objective slash authorization
implementation_summary: added append-only objective slash policy with frozen evidence-adapter code hash, violation predicate, optional verification-policy tuple and bounded penalty terms
worker and verifier collateral positions freeze exact slash-policy revision and commitment at first stake
added permissionless slash authorization that binds exact collateral position, subject, stake policy, evidence reference, misconduct key and bounded amount
added objective worker evidence for conflicting signed results on one canonical worker attempt
added objective verifier evidence requiring final independently adjudicated verifier-error dispute evidence
added replay protection and outstanding slash reservations that block collateral withdrawal without moving Vault funds
requirements_satisfied: slash authorization is separate from slash execution/distribution
later slash-policy revisions cannot retroactively alter existing collateral positions
evidence adapter address/code hash and violation predicate are frozen in policy
generic FAILED state is not sufficient worker slash evidence
generic adverse dispute disposition is not sufficient verifier slash evidence
worker evidence requires two conflicting canonical result digests signed by the frozen execution key for the same canonical attempt
verifier evidence requires terminal objective verifier-error adjudication and resolved independent appeal when appealed
authorization is permissionless to relay but subject/account/stake-policy/policy/evidence bound
authorization amount is bounded by slash bps, optional max cap and remaining unreserved slashable collateral
outstanding authorization blocks matured collateral withdrawal
authorization performs no Vault release, claim, redirect or distribution
